notes: Only the assigned scan014 brief, packet, supplied notation snapshot, and the three scan014 source images were read. All of notation_snapshot.md was read, with additional chunks used to recover tool-output truncation. No other scan, other reader output, outside source, OCR, text-recognition system or PDF text layer was used. No delegation was performed.

The whole source image was opened once for layout, followed by half_a once and half_b once in that order. Actual clock timestamps are in viewed. After listing the remaining open loci, 23 tight crops were generated, each inspected once. None of the whole image, halves or settled loci was reopened or recropped. A crop covering the crowded middle formula serves its distinct old-layer decisions; a crop covering ESt-ce and the following question serves the nearby small marks. Full crop processing and actual view timestamps are recorded.

start_utc is the first explicitly recorded clock reading in this run, after the initial text-packet reads and before any source image was opened. It is not a reconstructed earlier timestamp. Model identity is the identity exposed in the session; reasoning effort is not exposed.

Coverage: every text block and every inline/display formula, including agreed passages, was compared against both C and H. This included accents, endings, punctuation, abbreviations, relation strokes, alphabets, indices, degrees, all parenthetical strokes, the resolution underbrace and label, correction layers, heading underline, archive number and distinct marginal traces. This is a visual coverage statement, not a mathematical proof check.

The page is wholly handwritten, with a darker main manuscript layer and a lighter bottom-left archive number 13. Personal authorship of the hand is not established by this page and packet, so no writer is named. No generic handwritten wrapper is used for the wholly manuscript page. No visible author page number, date, title sheet, stated total page count, letterhead, salutation, closing or signature occurs here.

The first block labels case b), states preservation of injectivity and an epimorphism condition, gives an open-inclusion example, and writes a derived-section/kernel expression using an injective-resolution annotation. These statements were transcribed; they were not proved in this run.

The next paragraph states that taking the cone of a morphism of complexes is not functorial in the derived category relative to the arrow. The page then says that the present particular case ought to have a functorial choice and asks whether it is evident. The tentative question is retained; it is not a result established by this reader.

The last question is addressed to Illusie and mentions his theory of deformations of flat group schemes, H^3 and Ext^2 expressions with blank slots, Gr-champs and champs de Picard. The words supposée écrite explicitly qualify the proposed theory. The visible page ends with J'ai, without a continuation on this page; no claim about the remainder of a dossier is made.

The main mathematical ambiguities are transcriptional: the first g/q form, the incomplete head on the first relation, a C-shaped opening after the first display's high star, crowded cancelled layers in the second display, the small G/C index, and the K/X argument of Ext. Mathematical expectations were not used to restore missing strokes. The semicolon and separate comma in Ext are preserved even though the resulting blank-argument expression is unusual.

H's editorial notes were considered as content. H is credited with the rés. inj. annotation, with doubt about the C-shaped opener, with a cancelled tail and with uncertainty about X/K. The underbrace extent is a placement difference, not an omitted label. H's uncertainty about the argument letter does not by itself flag doubt about its separately described point-subscript; marked_in_H for the separator row is therefore false.

The clear hook-arrow, doubled R, underbrace extent, repeated example morphism, singular article le and absence of an internal court-circuiter hyphen were settled in a half. Their approximate whole-source boxes are retained in the corresponding changes entries, with no extra reader crops. The example morphism still inherits the page's first-occurrence g/q reservation.

The clipped edge marks are not completed into words, numbers or mathematical notation. They are preserved as small graphic approximations, with textual status left open. The separate low point around ESt-ce, high stroke after the question mark, and bottom dots are likewise retained without semantic attachment. The faint full-width gray line near the bottom is described as a paper/image rule, not asserted to be an authored underline.

No diagrams or independent mathematical constructions are present. The TikZ material in reading.tex only reproduces otherwise unassigned graphic fragments. No caret insertion is established; the middle formula has overlaid/cancelled material, represented as deletion layers.

No mathematical proof, independent re-proof, formal computation or theorem verification was performed. Counting visible delimiter curves, counting strokes and checking their placement were visual transcription actions. Accordingly math_checks is empty.
